_readme: Paste your IDs into the empty strings below, then run: npm run build
Anything left empty is simply not emitted — the build still succeeds.
ga4                    Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID, shaped like G-XXXXXXXXXX.
Get it: analytics.google.com -> Admin -> Data Streams -> your web stream -> Measurement ID.
(Creating the stream is what gives you the ID; there is no code to install by hand after that.)
googleSiteVerification The token from Search Console -> Add property -> URL prefix -> 'HTML tag' verification.
Copy only the long string inside content="...", not the whole <meta> tag.
bingSiteVerification   Optional, same idea from bing.com/webmasters. Bing can also just import your
Search Console property, in which case leave this empty.
None of these are secrets: all three end up in the public HTML, so this file is safe to commit.
